body_en:
## OUTBOARD

You can send in almost any typeof message for entry in OUTBOARD in any format: a DATA statement, Tasword file, handwritten letter etc. "Ideally", it should not be larger than 10 screen lines. Your message will be published, free of charge, monthly until: 
1. You request its removal; 
2. It gets "crowded off" by newer messages (when you may apply again for it to be re-entered); 
3. We consider it to have fulfilled its purpose (e.g. "Club meeting on the 6th").

## OUTLET EXTRA 1
Has the first 7 OUTCLASSES (best machine code for beginners ever!); JACKSOFT (m/code assembler); SINGLESTEP (run and display code step by step); COL80 (prints OUTLET text in up to 137 chars a line); OUTPRINT (prints 3 columns); OUTSTART (Disassembler); UNITRANS+ (tape file to Disciple/Opus/Mdrive); TRANSBACK (Opus file to tape); OUTDEX (Outlet index). SAME COST AS OUTLET FROM CHEZRON.
